scenes.title: Weight becomes a tiny mechanical bend
The load cell deforms under force
Calibration and tare make the reading useful

vo.text: Place an object on this digital scale, and its weight appears as a number.
vo.speak: Place an object on this digital scale, and its weight appears as a number.

vo.text: Inside, the platform bends a tiny metal element by an extremely small amount.
vo.speak: Inside, the platform bends a tiny metal element by an extremely small amount.

vo.text: That element is a load cell, built to deform predictably under force.
vo.speak: That element is a load cell, built to deform predictably under force.

vo.text: Thin strain gauges attached to it stretch or compress along with the metal.
vo.speak: Thin strain gauges attached to it stretch or compress along with the metal.

vo.text: Their electrical resistance changes, producing a small voltage signal.
vo.speak: Their electrical resistance changes, producing a small voltage signal.

vo.text: The scale's electronics amplify and convert that signal into a digital reading.
vo.speak: The scale's electronics amplify and convert that signal into a digital reading.

vo.text: Calibration relates the reading to weight units, while tare subtracts the container.
vo.speak: Calibration relates the reading to weight units, while tare subtracts the container.

vo.text: So a tiny mechanical bend becomes the number you see on the scale.
vo.speak: So a tiny mechanical bend becomes the number you see on the scale.
